pull-request-header: MedTracker 0.6 replaces Rails with the Rust/Loco application to reduce operating memory. Install it with a fresh PostgreSQL 18 database and new accounts; existing Rails databases and credentials are not migrated. Keep the previous database separately. This release follows a fix-forward approach; switching back to Rails cannot preserve records created in 0.6. See the [release notes](https://github.com/damacus/med-tracker/blob/main/docs/releases/0.6.md) for changes and known limitations, and the [installation guide](https://github.com/damacus/med-tracker/blob/main/docs/operations/loco-cutover-runbook.md) for configuration.
